notes: Dost 6.2 — App kholne ki bari fixing: (1) WhatsApp Business aur har app ab pakka khulegi — Dost pehle Home screen par jata hai; agar app list (drawer) na khule to ColorOS ki home screens par ek ek karke aage barhta hai, har screen ke naam parhta hai, app mile to tap karta hai. App kisi folder mein ho to woh bhi bata kar seedha khol deta hai — koshish kabhi khamosh nahi marti, aur har koshish ka record Action Log mein milta hai. (2) 'Earphone ki setting kholo' par ab SETTINGS khulegi, Phone nahi — naam hamesha pura lafz milta hai, kisi lafz ke andar chhupa naam nahi chalta; 'setting' bolne se Settings hi khulegi. Aur ghalti sudharne wala jumla ('phone NAHIN kholna tha, setting kholni hai') bhi hukum hi rahega — woh kabhi search ya Dimagh ki taraf nahi jayega. (3) Voice mode mein jawab bolte hue aap beech mein bol sakte hain — Dost jawab rok kar aap ki baat sunega; kuch sunai de aur samajh na aye to bol kar kahega 'samajh nahi aya, dobara bolen' — awaz khamoshi mein ghayab nahi hogi. (4) Voice wali purani guftagu ab har line par WAQT ke saath ayegi, aur naya session alag nishan ke saath — purani chat dobara aaj ka result nahi lagegi. (5) 'Aaj ka din...' lamba jumla bhi ab phone se hi jawab payega, web search se nahi. Ghair mulki (Chinese waghera) search results ab nahi ayenge; adhoora lafz ('je') type ho to Dost poochhega, Dimagh par kharach nahi hoga. (6) My Phone mein awaz ki halat ab asal saboot se ayegi: jo cheez istemal mein chal chuki hai wahan 'Works (proven in use)' ayega, 'Not reported' nahi. (7) Controller screen par ab version bhi likha ata hai: 6.2 (code 9).
